articleTitle: DASS: a Domain Augment Supervised SimCSE framework for sentence presentation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: Unsupervised/supervised SimCSE [1] achieves the SOTA performance of sentence-level semantic representation based on contrastive learning and dropout data augment. In particular, Supervised SimCSE mined positive pairs and hard-negative pairs through NLI entailment/contradiction labels, which significantly outperformed other unsupervised/supervised models. NLI data is scarce, can we construct pseudo-NLI data to improve the semantic representation of multi-domain sentences? This paper provides a Domain Augmented Supervised SimCSE approach (DASS), which includes (1) providing two pseudo-NLI data generators, "Hard/Soft NLI Data Builder", to annotate entailment/contradiction pairs through Business Rules and Neural Classifiers, respectively. (2) "Domain Augment InfoNCE" to balance the loss of multiple domains. Experiments show that DASS can achieve intra-domain enhancement and cross-domain enhancement. Moreover, with Soft NLI Builder, DASS can achieve the best results of all domains, improving 34% and 11% compared with baseline and strong baseline.

articleTitle: A hybrid neurodynamics algorithm for solving distributed nonconvex nonsmooth load sharing problems in power systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: In this paper, a hybrid neurodynamics optimizatio (HNO) algorithm is proposed, which is a distributed convex optimization algorithm combined with stochastic neurodynamics. The state solution of the HNO algorithm can avoid falling into local optimal solution by adding neural white noise. The results of numerical experiments show that HNO algorithm has better global optimization ability. In addition, we build a distributed load share (DLS) model. Different from the current model, which only focuses on the quadratic economic cost function, we not only consider the valve point effect and the environmental cost function of the fuel generator, but also consider the constraints of the transmission line which connects the bus. A distributed non-convex nonsmooth optimization problem is constructed. To solve this problem, we first smoothed each local objective function, then dealt with nonconvex constraints utilizing penalty function, and transformed the original problem into a distributed nonconvex optimization problem. Finally, the HNO algorithm is used to solve the problem. The optimization values of each variable in the power grid show that the power grid can operate in an optimal state under the condition of power limitation.

Author Keywords: valve point effect and the environmental cost function

articleTitle: Guided Deep Reinforcement Learning based on RBF-ARX Pseudo LQR in Single Stage Inverted Pendulum
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: The Guided Deep Reinforcement Learning (GDRL) method is proposed to train an optimal controller to stabilize a Single Stage Inverted Pendulum (SSIP). Firstly, the RBF (Radial Basis Function)-ARX (Auto Regressive Exogenous) without offset term model is applied to model a SSIP offline, using the data sampled from a simulated SSIP. Then, a Pseudo LQR (PLQR) is designed to provide guiding signals to the agent during the training process. Together with the policy gradient in deep reinforcement learning, the policy network is trained by the softly-combined gradient from both the action-value network and the model based PLQR. To improve the policy monotonically, a searching scheme with adjusted step size is applied during the training. All of these above consist of the proposed method. The simulation results demonstrate the superiority of training speed and controlling performance of the GDRL.

articleTitle: Prediction of RNA Modifications Based on Multi-interval Nucleotide Pair Mutual Information
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: RNA modifications are modified nucleotides with extra chemical groups, which are critical in a number of cellular and biological processes. It is essential to know the occurrence sites of these modifications for fully understanding the biological mechanisms. Here, we propose a method for identification of these sites with local and global information of RNA sequence. The sites of three most frequently observed modifications, i.e., m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup>A, m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>A, A-to-I, are predicted simultaneously. To build the predictor, features are extracted from the RNA sequences through bidirectional multi-interval nucleotide pair mutual information method at first. Then, the Elastic Net is used to reduce redundant and noisy information to remain crucial features. At last, the support vector machine (SVM) classifier is applied as the predictor with these optimal features. It has been shown via cross-validations that the accuracy achieved by the powerful new predictor are better than previous methods. It is expected that the proposed methods may be considered as a useful computing tool for RNA analysis.

articleTitle: Design of Differential Privacy Protection Algorithms for Cyber-Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: A new privacy Laplace common recognition algorithm is designed to protect users’ privacy data in this paper. This algorithm disturbs state transitions and information generation functions using exponentially decaying Laplace noise to avoid attacks. The mean square consistency and privacy protection performance are further studied. Finally, the theoretical results obtained are verified by performing numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Fast LMS-based Compound Algorithm for Modelling Long Memory Filters with Colored Signal
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: A new adaptive modelling technique (AP-NCD) is suggested to increase the speed and accuracy of modelling the long memory filter with strong correlation signals by integrating the alternating projection principle with the nonlinear multi-degree of freedom algorithm (NLMDF). The basic idea is to partition a huge filter into a set of sub filters of length m = 2 by using the notion of alternating projection, and then iterate through each sub filter using the NCD method derived from the NLMDF algorithm. The convergence characteristics of the AP-NCD algorithm are investigated in this study, and the principle of parameter selection is derived. The simulation results demonstrate that the AP-NCD algorithm has a faster convergence time and accuracy than the NLMDF, TPLMS, and DCTLMS algorithms when the high correlation input signal is used to model the long memory filter (FIR).

articleTitle: Battery Energy Storage System Cooperated with Wind Farm in the Energy and Regulation Market Considering Wind Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: Battery energy storage systems (BESSs) are at high cost, thus it brings challenges in gaining revenue when working independently. But when BESS provides assistance for wind power and participates in frequency modulation (FM) and energy markets together, it can bring significant benefits. This paper puts forward a BESS and wind farm cooperation scheme in a bidding problem. The BESS model uses the traditional depth of discharge (DoD) model. After the optimization, the rainflow counting method (RCM) is used to evaluate the accuracy of the BESS loss calculated in the optimization, which verifies the feasibility of the bidding model. And the economy and feasibility can be confirmed when the BESS provides assistance for wind power and participates in the market.

articleTitle: Scaled Consensus of Nonlinear Second-order Multi-agent Systems with Input Faults and Failures
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: This paper investigate the scaled consensus problem of the nonlinear second-order multi-agent systems with input faults and failures. To handle the considered problem, a novel scaled consensus protocol is designed, which is built based on the super-twisting observer. Through systematic Lyapunov stability analysis, the sufficient conditions for guaranteeing the stability of the closed-loop system are derived. Finally, simulation example is performed to verify the effectiveness of the designed algorithm.

articleTitle: Adaptive Control for Nonlinear MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: In this paper, a command-filter-based adaptive fuzzy control strategy is proposed for a class of nonlinear multiple input and multiple output(MIMO) systems with full state constraints. The appropriate barrier Lyapunov function is employed to prevent the constraints violation, and the command-filtered back-stepping control method is proposed to remove the explosion of differentiation and lessen the computational burden. In addition, fuzzy logic system is employed to approximate the unknown nonlinear function, and the proposed compensating signals can make up for the error caused by the command filters. The proposed control strategy guarantees that all signals in the closed-loop system are semiglobal uniformly ultimately bounded by adjusting those designed system parameters. The simulation result is introduced to verify the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Chance Constrained Weighted Goal Programming Based Optimal Operation for Integrated Energy System Considering Wind Power Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: Integrated Energy System (IES) is critical to improving energy efficiency and promoting the large-scale development of renewable energy sources. However, uncertain renewable wind energy brings challenges to the IES’s optimal operation. In this article, a chance constrained weighted goal programming (CCWGP) model is proposed to address this issue. First, the CCWGP is introduced to establish multiple chance constraints on gas turbine reserve capacity to achieve system risk quantification. Then, the objective function is established that aims to minimize the IES’s operating cost and risk. Finally, the state transition algorithm (STA), an intelligent optimization algorithm, is used to solve this high-dimensional complex problem in the multi-energy coupling system. Experimental results verify that the proposed method can effectively balance the safety and economy of the system.

articleTitle: Scheduling on unrelated parallel batch processing machines considering energy cost
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: The large amount of electricity consumption in the industrial sector has caused a large amount of greenhouse gas emissions, which has brought great pressure to the environment. The time-of-use (TOU) tariffs, i.e. the electricity prices are different in different periods of a day, are implemented by the government to alleviate this phenomenon. The TOU tariffs also provide managers an opportunity to reduce electricity cost by scheduling. This paper investigates an unrelated parallel batch processing machines scheduling problem under TOU tariffs. A mixed integer linear programming model is proposed for the problem and a heuristic is proposed to solve the problem. A large number of randomly generated instances are used to evaluate the model and the heuristic. The results prove that the model and the heuristic proposed in this paper are effective.

articleTitle: Synchronization of a Fourth-order Hyperchaotic System by Intermittent Control with Double Impulses
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: In this paper, we describe a hyperchaotic system with time-delay. The process of the system is composed of a drive system and a response system, which is controlled by an intermittent mode. Double impulses are added to enhance the control, which is closer to the actual situation. According to Lyapunov stability theory, Linear Matrix Inequality (LMI), double impulses and intermittent control theory, and considering the approximation method of delay equation, an exponential synchronization condition of error system is given. The validity of the conclusion is realized by computer simulation.

articleTitle: Finding the Optimal Network Topology for the Distributed Multi-Short-Paths Routing Algorithm — A Genetic Algorithm-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: In artificial transmission networks, the use of the distributed multi-short-paths (DMSP) routing algorithm can effectively improve the network transmission performance. This paper proposes a network topology optimization algorithm based on genetic algorithm, which can be used to find the optimal network topology suitable for the DMSP routing algorithm. We realized the algorithm on computer, and made a preliminary observation on the optimal topology obtained by it. It is found that the optimal topology has the characteristics of homogeneity, small characteristic path, and no community aggregation.

articleTitle: Early-Stage Diagnosis of Panax Notoginseng Plant Blight Disease by Multispectral Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: Panax notoginseng plant blight disease is one of the major diseases in planting. It is of great significance for controlling disease and spraying precisely to realize early grading detection of Panax notoginseng plant blight disease. In this paper, RGB camera and MAPIR Survey3W multispectral camera are used to collect the image data of infected leaves and healthy leaves in the early stage of the disease. Through principal component analysis(PCA), we find a channel that can cover most of the information of spectral pictures by analogy. Methods of competitive adaptive reweighted sampling(CARS) and successive projections algorithm (SPA) are used to screen the channel characteristic bands. Then PCA algorithm and SPA algorithm are combined to reduce the dimension of the results after CARS screening. We used the full spectrum data and the data after feature screening as inputs to establish an early disease detection model of Panax notoginseng based on spectral information. Combined with the comprehensive evaluation of the number of characteristic bands and the computational complexity, the neural network detection model based on CARS-BP with high classification accuracy is the best. The research shows that the detection model established by using spectral information can realize the early classification detection of natural disease of Panax notoginseng, and provide theoretical support for early disease prevention and precision pesticide spraying.

articleTitle: Robust H∞ consensus of multi-agent systems with the event-triggered scheme under semi-Markov switching topologies with partially unknown rates
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: Robust H∞ consensus control of multi-agent systems with the event-triggered scheme and semi-Markov switching topologies with partially unknown rates is investigated in this paper to suppress system uncertainty and external disturbance. By defining the error variable, the consensus problem is firstly converted to the stability problem of the error system. A sampling-data event-triggered protocol is introduced to avoid the continuous communication between agents and co-design the gain of consensus controller and the event-triggered parameters matrix. The external disturbance is considered by both the leader and follower, the sufficient conditions are presented to guarantee the H∞ performance in accordance with linear matrix inequalities. Finally, the suppression of external input disturbance using the proposed method is verified by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Distributed dynamic event-triggered control on bipartite tracking consensus of linear multi-agent system in the cooperation-competition network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: The bipartite tracking consensus problem with distributed dynamic event-triggered control for linear multi-agent systems is studied in this article under the cooperation-competition network. The network is structurally balanced and connected, which means that the entire network could be divided into two subnetworks, with cooperation internally and competition externally. To achieve bipartite tracking consensus, a distributed dynamic event-triggered control method is designed, where the state feedback control law is based on its own latest observations and the relative information of neighboring agents. The introduction of trigger mechanism enhances the efficient utilization of communication and computation resources. With the help of tools from Lyapunov stability theory and graph theory, all agents can reach bipartite tracking consensus with an exponential convergence rate. Then, it is proved that, with the dynamic event-triggering scheme, no agent exhibits Zeno behavior. Finally, a numerical example is delivered to demonstrate the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis.

publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: Vision-based geo-location is very important for many military applications, especially when the global navigation satellite system (GNSS) is unavailable. However, this is not an easy task and faces many challenges due to the changes of vegetation, illumination and season in mountainous regions. In this work, we regard automatic geo-localization without GNSS recordings as a skyline matching problem, and propose an automated approach for visual localization using digital elevation model (DEM) data and real-captured images. The skyline feature is used as a cue for visual database retrieval. Our system was tested on 50 testing site points within a large-scale area (China, 202.6 km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) and an average position error of 43.13 m was obtained within 4.5 s, which demonstrates that this low-cost approach can produce fast and reliable localization results.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Cybersecurity Performance in Intrusion Detection Systems Based on Fuzzy VIKOR and the Nash Equilibrium
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Intelligent Systems and Computational Intelligence (ICISCI)
abstract: Intrusion detection system (IDS) is a kind of network security device that can monitor network traffic immediately and send alarm or take active response measures when finding suspicious transmission. As malicious attacks continue to change and occur in very large numbers, it is essential to evaluate the cybersecurity performance and select a flexible and effective IDS matching the corresponding protection requirements. In this study, the evaluation of cybersecurity performance in IDS is established as a fuzzy multi-attribute decision making (MADM) problem, and the performance of IDS is comprehensively evaluated in 8 indexes, such as spam detection, phishing identification, anomaly detection, etc. In MADM, fuzzy analytic hierarchy process is used to reflect the relative importance of each evaluation index based on the actual requirements of protection and the preference of domain experts, i.e. the subjective attribute weights. To avoid subjectivity randomness of preferences expression, the fuzzy entropy weight method based on α-cut is used to measure intrinsic information in decision making matrix and determine the objective weight of each evaluation index. And on this basis, the Nash Equilibrium is introduced to integrate the subjective and objective attribute weights, so as to retain more raw information about the different types of attribute weights. Finally, the fuzzy VIKOR is used to comprehensively evaluate each IDS and select the optimal IDS. Experimental results verify that the proposed method can be used to choose the best IDS flexibly and efficiently.
